programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Street racing in the US is the subject of this docu-reality series, which purportedly provides an inside look into the action both on the road and behind the scenes. In Oklahoma City, for example, racers boast having the fastest street cars in the country, and the racing, they say, comes first - before family, before friends and before work. From a 1969 Chevy Nova to a race-ready farm truck, the vehicles - and their drivers - come in all shapes and sizes and have one thing in common: the need for speed.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: Python Hunters
programme.desc: With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.desc: As Robert McCall finds himself forming a new bond with the locals of an Italian town, the region's oppression by the Mafia triggers him to protect his people.

programme.title: The International

programme.title: Fatherhood
programme.desc: A widower embarks on an emotional journey while raising his daughter single-handedly despite encountering several hurdles along the way.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.

programme.title: Ghost Rider

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: A hard-living superhero who has fallen out of favor with the public enters into a questionable relationship with the wife of the public relations professional who's trying to repair his image.

programme.title: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: A group of co-workers embark on a team-building exercise on an uninhabited island. However, when their ex-marine guide is killed, they are left stranded and must struggle to survive.

programme.title: Men in Black 3

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter

programme.title: The Water Horse

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1986, Cuban trumpeter Arturo Sandoval brought his band with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Featuring talented performers like pianist Hilario Durán and guitarist Jorge Chicoy, they displayed a master class in Latin jazz fusion.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: American trumpeter Randy Brecker and saxophonist Bennie Wallace bring their band of pianist Eliane Elias, drummer Peter Erskine and bassist Marc Johnson to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Omer Avital -- Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences; at Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital presents singular repertoire based on his album "Qantar."

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Kenny Garrett emerged in the early 1980s, redefining the alto sax with powerful intensity. His album Sounds from the Ancestors blends jazz, R&B and gospel roots from Detroit with a modern global sound.

programme.title: Chucho Valdes at Bata Jazz Malta 2019
programme.desc: Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brings his band Jazz Batá Two to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019; they deliver a performance that reverberates through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas: Live at Casino de Paris
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris shows the British singer-songwriter at her best; this concert is part of La Havas' "Blood Tour", promoting her second album "Blood."

programme.title: Kenny Barron at Lviv Ukraine 2019
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv is a celebration of jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Donna Lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage; a look at Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument.

programme.title: Christian McBride Quartet at Malta 2018
programme.desc: Double bassist Christian McBride presents his band New Jawn at the Malta Jazz Festival on July 20, 2018; hailing from Philadelphia, this musician combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah at Sofia Bulgaria 2019
programme.desc: In 2019, the city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival; among the featured acts is the jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: In 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren; the concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, both long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio.

programme.title: Christian McBride Quartet at Malta 2018
programme.desc: Double bassist Christian McBride presents his band New Jawn at the Malta Jazz Festival on July 20, 2018; hailing from Philadelphia, this musician combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Newport Jazz Festival 1968
programme.desc: In 1968, jazz artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam; this broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Jazz à la Grand' Place : Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two Belgian musicians, guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse, accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the Brussels Jazz Club.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen at Lviv Ukraine 2017
programme.desc: Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David and Omri Mor join forces with the International Symphony Orchestra INSO-Lviv, conducted by Christian Schumann.

programme.title: Buck Clayton
programme.desc: Trumpeter Buck Clayton is joined by pianist Henri Chaix, double bassist Théo Siegrist, and drummer Pierre Bourru.

programme.title: Miles Davis: Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis pioneered bebop, cool jazz, hard bop, modal jazz, and electronic music; on October 11, 1964, he performed in Milan with tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams.

programme.title: Great Guitarists
programme.desc: This selection of performances by some of the most influential jazz guitarists in history showcases their unique essence.

programme.title: The Great Charlie Galbraith All Star Jazz Band
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted the talented groups of Charlie Galbraith, Knut Kiesewetter, Bud Shank and Pim Jacobs and Marc Laferrière in a jazz festival that mixed new and old styles.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah at Sofia Bulgaria 2019
programme.desc: In 2019, the city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival; among the featured acts is the jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah.

programme.title: Long Tall Dexter Live in '64
programme.desc: Featuring three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop musician's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Live in Paris
programme.desc: Larry Graham and Graham Central Station perform at the Trianon in Paris, where 600 attendees watch the renowned bass player. Graham, a pioneer of slap-pop electric bass, shows his skill.

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: The recording captures Tony Bennett's performance at London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, showcasing his vocal skill and charisma.

programme.title: Guitarlegend in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the unique and influential guitarists in music history. This rare footage illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: In 1986, the third version of jazz fusion band Mahavishnu Orchestra, composed of guitarist John McLaughlin, pianist Jim Beard, bassist Jonas Hellborg, drummer Danny Gottlieb and saxophonist Bill Evans, played at the North Sea Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius: Live and Outrageous
programme.desc: Jazz legend Jaco Pastorius takes the stage at the 1982 Montreal Jazz Festival with bandmates Randy Brecker, Peter Erskine, Bobby Mintzer, Don Alias and Othello Molineaux.
